title: Verify: ambient-room.wav resolves and has a RIFF header unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the audio manifest path
description: Add game/tests/publicAssetAudio.test.ts that reads the manifest and the WAV read-only and asserts existence, non-empty size and RIFF/WAVE header.
acceptance_criteria: WAV path exists and is non-empty

steps.action: Find the manifest asset with id audio:ambient-room. Add it('file exists and is non-empty') using statSync(join(root, asset.path)).size > 0; it('has RIFF WAVE header') reading the buffer and asserting toString('ascii',0,4)==='RIFF' and toString('ascii',8,12)==='WAVE'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/publicAssetAudio.test.ts
